complete_native_numeric_diagnostic.endpoint_scope: Precommitted ordinary and IA-weighted micro-F curves at every native threshold; unchanged1e-12 bound.
complete_native_numeric_diagnostic.raw_column_diagnostic_scope: All native numeric columns retained separately. NumPy reduction layout can change large weighted raw FP/MI/Smin by final-place roundoff; no point curve or scoring formula is changed.

limitations: Previously exposed CAFA5 retrospective development comparison, not fresh confirmation or independent study replication.
ProtNote uses 2019 ProteInfer random splits and E5 released2024. Actual supervised/homology overlap is not reconstructed, so NK/LK does not establish unseen training sequences or Pharos Tdark.
Reference-unmatched forecasts are not biological negatives; Fmax is maximized over the benchmark grid and fixed0.5 is not calibrated biological probability.
Different vocabulary/full-sequence/text-encoder/training profiles are bundled method differences; no causal attribution to one mechanism.
Native reference/TOI score projection may exclude class outputs, but cannot define the numerical prediction axis.
No whole-Pharos biological-accuracy percentage, new validated function or automatic graph pruning follows this bounded comparison.

prediction_axis.content: all nonobsolete GO terms with both native name and definition from the one pinned GO2023 ontology
prediction_axis.ordering: GO_ID ascending, each name then definition
prediction_axis.text_cleanup: unchanged upstream native definition and obsolete-string cleanup; published E5 task instruction; mean pooling and account_for_sos=True
prediction_axis.missing_definitions: explicit ontology exclusions, not outcome-driven; retain full native evaluation denominators
prediction_axis.sequence_input: whole dated sequence; fixed native canonical20AA axis; no inferred U/X substitutions

inference.fallback: Missing/noncanonical/native OOM or nonfinite scores are explicit unscorable rows; never silently drop reference cases or alter residues. Preserve failure and assess complete original denominators. No automatic alternate model/precision/sweep.
